items.name: style
items.prompt:
You are a motion-graphics art director and retention editor studying a viral 2.5-minute vertical geography video ('8 Geography Myths You Probably Still Believe!', Map Facts, ~935K views in 5 days). We are making our OWN video on the same 8 myths with our own script and art; study ONLY the visual and editing craft, never copy wording. Write in English, concrete, with timestamps for every example.
1. SHOT LOG: every cut with timestamp, what is on screen (map type: satellite / flat / globe / photo / stock video / illustration), camera move, and on-screen text. One line per shot.
2. PACING: average shot length, longest hold, cuts per myth, how each myth's number card / title appears and how long it stays.
3. TEXT AND CAPTIONS: caption style (font, size, colour, position, word-by-word or phrase), title cards, stat callouts, emoji.
4. MAP AND REVEAL TECHNIQUES: how each myth's 'wrong' moment and truth reveal is shown (comparisons, overlays, scale bars, red X, zooms).
5. SOUND: music style and energy, sound effects on cuts and reveals, any silence.
6. RETENTION DEVICES: what keeps viewers from swiping between myths; where it is weakest.
7. Ten concrete things a premium horizontal 16:9 version with 3D globes and terrain should do BETTER than this video.
